capacity.why: notifications of deaths and births, and requests for certified copies, entered by the counter staff

issues.does: Registers a death on the notification of it: the entry is what a bank, the land registry and the family act on, and it is sent to whoever reported the death.

children.description: The dead person's children, as the notification names them.

estate.description: Those written to where nobody of the family reported the death and the estate is to be administered.

notification.description: The notification of the death that the entry is made on.

partner.description: The dead person's partner, if the notification names one.

reported_by.description: Who reported the death: they are sent the entry.

tell.description: Those the notification asks to be told, who are sent the entry too.

without_adult.description: Children left with no adult at home, as the notification names them.

issues.title: Entry in the register of deaths

sends.why: They are sent every entry in the register of deaths as of right, to keep their own records by: whoever keeps a roll of electors takes the dead off it, and whoever pays someone a pension or support stops paying it.

issues.does: Gives whoever asks a certified copy of a death already registered.
issues.title: Certified copy of an entry of death

issues.does: Registers a birth on the notification of it, and sends the entry to whoever reported it.

born_at.description: When the child was born, as the notification gives it.

reported_by.description: Who reported the birth: they are sent the entry.

issues.title: Entry in the register of births

sends.why: They are sent every entry in the register of births as of right, to keep their own records by.

issues.does: Asks the land registry to pass a dead owner's land to the heir the law of succession names.

heir.description: Whom the land passes to, as the law of succession says.

issues.title: Application to the land registry for a dead owner's land to pass

sends.why: The land registry keeps the titles to land: passing a dead owner's land is its to do.

writes.text: Transmission on death: whatever land {deceased} held passes to {heir}.

papers.how: entered in the register from the notification, and those entitled are told of the entry
entered in the register from the notification, and those entitled are told of the entry

routines.what: The office's counter staff enter in the register each notification of a death or of a birth that comes to the office, and those entitled are told, each working day, so that the registrar is not brought back for it.
